hook_text: Why can you tile a floor with hexagons but never with pentagons? The corners hold the secret.
clip_script: Mrs Mokoena's paving yard in Kimberley! Slide a brick: translation. Flip a triangle: reflection. Turn a paver: rotation. Same size every time! Now pave a courtyard. Squares: four corners meet, a full turn, no gaps. Hexagons: three meet, perfect, like a honeycomb. Pentagons? Three leave a gap, four overlap. No tessellation! The corners must make a full turn.
visual_style: Pavers sliding, flipping and spinning into place from above, with angle arcs glowing where corners meet.
mood: Satisfying and rhythmic, like a tiling video.
pacing: Snappy moves, a slow-motion gap with pentagons, then a full courtyard reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and design a tessellation with two shapes.
